source.author: verg
source.text: Est antiquus ager Tusco mihi proximus amni, longus in occasum, finis super usque Sicanos; Aurunci Rutulique serunt et vomere duros exercent colles atque horum asperrima pascunt.
source.text_original: Est antiquus ager Tusco mihi proximus amni, / longus in occasum, finis super usque Sicanos; / Aurunci Rutulique serunt et vomere duros / exercent colles atque horum asperrima pascunt.
source.text_english: There is an ancient tract of land near the Tuscan river, stretching far toward the setting sun, reaching as far as the Sicanians; the Aurunci and the Rutuli till it and, with the plow, work the hard hills, and they pasture the roughest parts of it.

reuse.author: hier
reuse.text: quanti enim operantur terram et exercent uomere et tamen multis inpedientibus causis egestate conficiuntur et penuria!
reuse.text_original: quanti enim operantur terram et exercent uomere et tamen multis inpedientibus causis egestate conficiuntur et penuria!
reuse.text_english: For many who till the earth and work with the plow are nevertheless ruined by poverty and want because of many hindering causes!
